# MetalCalc

> Free, client-only web app for live precious metal (gold, silver, platinum, palladium), US stock, and
> cryptocurrency tracking, plus 20+ financial calculators. No account, no backend database — everything runs
> in the browser and is stored locally on the user's device. Free to use, ad-supported.

MetalCalc pulls live prices from gold-api.com and frankfurter.dev (metals/FX), Finnhub (US stocks), and
CoinGecko (crypto) — no paid data feed, no login required. All portfolio/holdings/alert data is stored in the
browser's localStorage only; nothing is sent to a server except optional WhatsApp/Telegram trade-alert delivery
(user opt-in) and live price API calls.

## Metals

- [Home](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/): Live gold/silver/platinum/palladium ticker, purity calculator, gold-silver ratio, local price history.
- [Batch Calculator](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/batch): Value multiple gold/silver/platinum items at once; save/share/export batches.
- [My Holdings](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/holdings): Persistent metals portfolio with live value, gain/loss, break-even price, CSV import/export, diversification score.
- [Compare Batches](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/compare): Compare two saved metal batches side by side.
- [Price Alerts](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/alerts): Browser notification alerts when a metal crosses a target price.

## Markets

- [US Stocks](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/stocks): Search US stocks, fundamentals (PE, PEG, EPS, growth), curated AI/Semi/Tech rankings, trade signals, portfolio tracking with cost-basis/realized-gains, WhatsApp/Telegram trade alerts.
- [Crypto](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/crypto): Search crypto, Top 10/25/50 by market cap, curated rankings, per-timeframe (15min-3month) technical trade signals, DCA backtest simulator, portfolio tracking, correlation check, move alerts.
- [Crude Oil](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/crude-oil): WTI/Brent crude oil price proxy and oil-market news.
- [Net Worth Dashboard](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/net-worth): Combined net worth across metals, stocks and crypto, with a diversification score and combined P&L.
- [Position Sizing / Risk Calculator](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/position-size): Fixed-fractional position sizing for stocks or crypto trades.

## Tools

- [Purity Converter](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/convert): Convert gold purity between karat, fineness and percent.
- [Weight Converter](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/weight-converter): Convert precious metal weight between grams, troy ounces, kilograms, tola, dwt.
- [Alloy Mixing Calculator](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/alloy-mix): Melt two different-purity gold/silver pieces together, compute blended purity.
- [Zakat Calculator](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/zakat): Calculate zakat due on gold, silver and cash using live prices and the silver nisab threshold.
- [Loan Against Gold](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/loan-against-gold): Estimate max loan amount a lender might offer against gold/silver.
- [Savings Goal Projector](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/savings-goal): See how long it takes to reach a gold/silver weight goal at a fixed monthly savings amount.
- [Storage & Insurance Cost Calculator](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/storage-cost): Estimate storage/insurance carrying cost and break-even price appreciation.
- [Melt vs Retail Markup Checker](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/melt-check): Check markup of a jewelry/coin asking price over its pure melt value.
- [Jewelry Bill Breakdown](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/bill-breakdown): Reveal implied making-charge + tax hidden in a lump-sum jewelry bill.
- [Exchange Rate Margin Checker](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/rate-check): Compare a dealer quoted FX rate against live mid-market rate.
- [Tax / GST Reverse Calculator](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/tax-reverse): Back out base price and tax amount from a final tax-inclusive price.
- [Backup & Restore](https://metal-calc-two.vercel.app/backup): Export/import all saved data as one JSON file.
